verdict.summary: BitMine is an Ethereum treasury platform whose current asset scale has outrun its audited operating history. The August 23 update reported 5.85 million ETH, 210 BTC and $14.9 billion of crypto, cash and selected investments; 5.07 million ETH was staked at a disclosed seven-day annualized yield of 2.67%. Management projected $330 million annualized staking revenue at the current staked balance and $381 million when fully staked, but those are forward-looking run rates, not GAAP guidance. The latest Form 10-Q covers the quarter ended May 31, before the bulk of the treasury expansion, so its income statement is a poor proxy for today's balance sheet. Capital claims matter: the June offering sold 3.5 million 9.5% preferred shares at $80 for $280 million gross; their $100 liquidation value creates a $350 million senior claim and $33.25 million annual dividends. A C+ grade recognizes scale but cannot certify NAV accretion or controls. The $25.68 reference is rejected because verified overhead pivots do not provide a viable first-target reward.

business.overview:
BitMine's economic engine is now an Ethereum treasury: capital is raised, ETH is acquired and most holdings are staked for protocol yield. The August update reported 5.85M ETH and 5.07M staked; legacy mining and other operating revenue are no longer the useful valuation anchor. The 2.67% seven-day annualized staking yield must also clear $33.25M of annual preferred dividends at full issuance.

The AI transmission channel is indirect and network-based. If AI agents use Ethereum for payments, identity, tokenized assets or coordination, higher settlement demand could support ETH value and staking fees. BitMine itself does not report AI software or data-center revenue, so the channel remains an ETH adoption thesis.

The model breaks if ETH declines, staking yield falls, validators are slashed, custody or smart contracts fail, or issuance grows faster than ETH per diluted common share. Preferred dividends and opaque values for strategic investments also reduce residual NAV available to common holders.
business.moat: BitMine's advantage is capital access and treasury scale: holding 4.8% of ETH supply can support institutional staking operations and market visibility. ETH is fungible, however, and scale is not a moat if financing terms transfer value from common holders or staking execution underperforms.

The June 5 424B5 sold 3.5M 9.5% Series A perpetual preferred shares at $80 for $280M gross before fees; their $100 stated and liquidation value creates a $350M senior claim and $33.25M annual dividends. The September 2025 placement separately offered 5,217,715 common shares plus 10,435,430 warrants exercisable at $87.50. Adding at least 18.17M May-disclosed potential shares produces a 621.37M minimum observable diluted denominator. A complete current fully diluted bridge is explicitly unavailable, so the NAV scenario cannot claim a final denominator.

filings.finding: The May-quarter 10-Q is the latest periodic filing and supplies the audited-style liquidity and control baseline, but it predates most of the $14.9B Ethereum treasury transformation.
The August 24 8-K furnishes the current treasury update reporting 5.85M ETH, 87% staked, $308M cash and securities, and a forward-looking $330M annualized staking-revenue estimate.

The 2025 10-K establishes legacy operations and the annual internal-control baseline; its historical revenue mix is not representative of the subsequently constructed Ethereum treasury and staking strategy.

The June 5 prospectus records a primary offering of 3.5M 9.5% perpetual preferred shares sold at $80 for $280M gross before fees; the $100 liquidation value creates a $350M senior claim and $33.25M annual dividends.
The June 3 prospectus documents the related preferred security terms and preliminary offering structure; it is preferred financing, not common issuance, debt borrowing or an ordinary ATM sale.

The April S-3ASR creates automatic shelf registration capacity but reports no completed sale, proceeds or dilution by itself; subsequent prospectus supplements must identify actual issued instruments and amounts.

The April S-3 registration statement creates offering capacity and is not issuance evidence; classifying it as common, preferred or debt requires the later security-specific prospectus and sale disclosure.

The September 22 primary placement offered 5,217,715 common shares at $70 plus 10,435,430 warrants for no additional consideration, exercisable at $87.50 through March 22, 2027, for $365.240M gross. It is completed equity-linked financing, not debt, preferred issuance or unsold shelf capacity.

contrarianRisks: The June 424B5 sold preferred equity with a 9.5% coupon; it was not common issuance and it creates a senior dividend claim.
The April S-3ASR provides shelf capacity but does not itself prove securities were sold.
The latest 10-Q predates most treasury growth, leaving no current GAAP margin bridge.
Issuer annualized staking revenue is a forward-looking snapshot exposed to yield and ETH changes.
Beast and Eightco holdings should not be valued as cash without liquidity and marketability discounts.
